newsitem.title: UK: Slough accepts reduction in damages claim.
newsitem.headline: Slough accepts reduction in damages claim.

text.p: British real estates company Slough Estates Plc said that it has settled for a reduction in the 49 million pounds ($82.6 million) damages awarded to the firm from Welwyn Hatfield District Council, a UK local authority.

Slough announced on Friday that it has agreed to accept 29.75 million pounds from the local council in what it described as a "pragmatic solution" in view of the limited funds available to the council.
The company was originally awarded 49 million last year for fraudulent misrepresentation by the council.
Slough has already received 10 million pounds from the council and the remainder is due within 14 days.
